faq.q: How do I make a video from a product link?
faq.a: Paste the URL, pick an actor and a voice, check the script, choose a size and a length, then download or publish to TikTok or Meta.

faq.q: Can I use a public Shopify or Amazon page?
faq.a: Yes, when the page opens without a login and shows the variant you sell.

faq.q: What if the page requires a login?
faq.a: Upload the product photo directly. A locked page cannot be read.

faq.q: Can reviews on the page appear in the clip?
faq.a: Yes. When the page has reviews, they can be brought into the script so the clip mentions what buyers already said.

faq.q: How many credits does a URL to video clip use?
faq.a: A clip uses 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15 or 120 for 30. If the job fails, those credits return to your balance.

faq.q: Can I make clips for several product links at once?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the links you want and make a clip for each one, instead of rebuilding every ad by hand.

faq.q: Can I edit the script, the voice and the captions?
faq.a: Yes. Change the script, swap the voice, fix a caption and pick a track in the editor before you download or publish.

faq.q: How long do I wait for a clip from a product page?
faq.a: You confirm the actor, the script and the credit cost, and the clip is prepared for download. If the job fails, those credits come back. The file itself is 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds long.

faq.q: Can I publish to TikTok or Meta?
faq.a: Yes. Send the finished clip to TikTok or Meta from the same screen, or download it. Finished files can be used commercially, with no watermark. Check each platform's rules before you scale spend.

faq.q: Is a person in the clip a real customer?
faq.a: No. Any person on screen is AI-generated, not a customer endorsement.
